summary: px8my ships a browser redirect payload distributed via npm/jsDelivr with a domain-rotation republish script
details: The package's main entry (px.js) is a browser-only IIFE that overlays a full-screen loading mask and injects an iframe pointing at an external domain (mfmz.sjz-ms.cn/H.html). A helper script (update_px8my.sh) rotates that destination domain, bumps the package version, republishes to npm, and purges the jsDelivr cache, effectively using npm as a CDN for a rotating redirect payload embedded in third-party web pages. No npm lifecycle hooks are declared and px.js references only browser DOM APIs, so npm install or require('px8my') in Node performs no action against the installer. The concrete harm falls on end-users of any web page that embeds this script from jsDelivr, not on developers who install the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
